items.question: Can the previously described configuration ever occur in future or past time?
premises: The described configuration will not come into being.
The described configuration has not existed in the past.
This denial is explicitly declared as truth.
items.inference: Therefore, the described configuration is impossible at all times and this impossibility is authoritatively affirmed.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the denied configuration depends on the preceding verses' description.
items.plain_english: It will not be, nor has it ever been; this is declared as the truth, this is declared.
